How to Install:
[list]
[*][size=2]Download the mod[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract the zip file[/size]
[*][size=2]Paste the shirts.xnb file into ".../Stardew Valley/Content/Characters/Farmer", replacing the original shirts.xnb file[/size]
[*][size=2]Don't forget to back up the original shirts.xnb file, in case you want to roll it back.[/size]
[/list][size=2]Requires:
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Get Dressed Mod by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/501530/?]Advize[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/8386684/?]Jinxiewinxie[/url] (Download [b][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-get-dressed-updated-for-1-1.113731/]Here[/url][/b])[/size]
[*][size=2]SMAPI 1.12 or higher (Download [b][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-stardew-modding-api.108375/]Here[/url][/b])[/size]
[/list]
Thanks for the support! [color=#f4f4f4]♥♥♥[/color]
